description: This file defines the SSOClient class, which is a client for interacting with the AWS Single Sign-On service. It includes method annotations indicating available operations such as credential retrieval, account roles listing, account listing, and logout functionality, both synchronously and asynchronously.

classes.name: SSOClient
classes.description: A client class for AWS Single Sign-On service, extending the base AwsClient class to provide specific methods for SSO operations.

methods.name: getRoleCredentials
methods.description: Retrieves temporary credentials for a role.

methods.name: getRoleCredentialsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves temporary credentials for a role.

methods.name: listAccountRoles
methods.description: Lists the roles available for an account.

methods.name: listAccounts
methods.description: Lists the AWS accounts accessible via SSO.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Logs out of the SSO session.

methods.name: logoutAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously logs out of the SSO session.
